localValidation.CSSChange: Remove only backdrop-filter:blur(8px); from the modal overlay.

limitations: A failing or incomplete attempt does not qualify a target; failures and missing reports remain explicit.
All absolute and growth caps retain their preexisting values; the added64MiB late-median and5s observation-gap budgets were declared before measurement.
The separate53-case functional suite is not run by this selected performance-only configuration.
Even a passing15minute disposable Linux run does not satisfy the required eight-hour installed working-day soak, full ten-target native matrix, vendor traffic or any whole readiness gate.
Held BSD source mapping, Mac launch diagnostics, private-output architecture selection and signing public identities remain unresolved; this attempt changes none of those grants.

interpretation: Removing modal blur reduced observed WebKit editor paint times in these two cohorts and moved AMD64 editor p95 below500ms. ARM64 editor latency, both standalone WebKit readiness caps and both sustained Firefox absolute-memory caps still fail. No complete performance qualification or hardware-independent causal guarantee is claimed.
